Callout.Name: Sting Operation
Callout.Message: Sting in progress, suspects about to arrive.
Callout.Advisory: Two vehicles expected, plain-clothes officers already in place.

Script.Line: The buy is set for ten minutes from now.
Two of them on a scooter, same as last week.
Nobody moves until I say so. That is the whole point of this.

Lines.Approach: Everybody is in position and they are expecting two vehicles. Do not roll up in front of them.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
